limits: One trajectory per case/setup/implementation; not repeated independent samples under one final implementation.
Several fixes changed together between rounds; request counts and latency do not isolate causal contributions.
Successful execution, exact quotes, and sender checks do not certify semantic sufficiency of summaries or recommendations.
The32k budget is deliberate pressure testing; observed failures do not establish default120k failure rates.
Only fixed sources and known URLs used; fresh source discovery and Tavily quality not evaluated.
Private reasoning is not retained or inspected; no claim about internal reinforcement mechanisms.
Restricted-phase ordinary tool calls still occur and are blocked; no claim that model misuse is eliminated.
interpretation_of_prepared_progress: Final prepared/unprepared pairs did not show uniform efficiency benefit: Meridian18 vs8 model calls, Vault18 vs32. The workflows include different prepared state and newest-result positions, one trajectory per pair, and deliberate32k pressure. These support possible usefulness in recovery, not stable causal improvement.
